label: Property Name
source_label: Property name in RR header block (also in AR/T12 headers)
notes: Drives Cover!B5, every sheet title (=IF('Prop Info'!B4=""...)), and the Rent Roll Analysis / T-12 Analysis health checks. Present in all four operator doc header blocks.

label: Total Units
notes: Prop Info!B6 is the denominator for occupancy %, PUPM, and the Rent Roll Analysis G5 reconciliation (RR count I5 must equal B6).

label: Rent Roll period / as-of date
notes: RR Analysis A5 'Date:' label cell. Exact target cell for the value (vs label) to be confirmed when the writer is built.

label: T-12 period range
notes: Drives the 12 monthly column headers on T-12 Analysis Layer 1 (C105:N105). The T-12 monthly columns and period must align with the operator's actual months.

label: Building
notes: Source 'Bldg-Unit' (e.g. 'A1') splits: building prefix -> A, unit -> B. Hidden Lakes uses single-letter building + unit number.

label: Unit #
notes: Unit portion of 'Bldg-Unit'.

label: Unit Type
notes: MF floorplan code (bed x bath). Feeds the floor-plan rollups in Recapture & Upside / Rental Comps.

label: Unit Status
notes: Template's status taxonomy is matched by COUNTIF wildcards: 'Occupied*', 'Vacant Unrented Ready', 'Vacant Unrented Not Ready', 'Down*', 'Vacant*Leased*'/'Vacant Rented*', 'Model'/'Employee'/'Office', 'Occupied No Notice'. Operator 'Unit Status' values (e.g. 'Occupied No Notice', 'Vacant Unrented Not Ready') already align closely; a future normalizer should confirm/standardize the closed vocab. proposed until the status-string map is locked.

label: Resident
notes: Vacant units show '-- Vacant --'. The '**' prefix convention drives the Legal flag (see rr_legal).

label: Legal / Eviction flag
notes: Template col G is a boolean used by Section C (legal/eviction cohort), Q5 legal count, and B113/D113 (units flagged + AR exposure). Derive from the '**' name prefix; the Eviction Status Report / bankruptcy disclosures in the DD checklist may refine. 9 active evictions + 1 bankruptcy known on Hidden Lakes.

label: Move-In Date
notes: Drives the Resident Tenure Cohort analysis (Section G uses TODAY()-H).

label: Lease End
notes: Drives the Lease Expiration Schedule (Section E, 24-month forward buckets keyed on col J).

label: Expected Move-Out
notes: Notice-to-vacate / scheduled move-out. Mostly blank in the source unless a move-out is scheduled.

label: Market Rent
notes: Drives Market GPR (Section D B26), loss-to-lease, and vacancy loss.

label: Actual Charges
notes: Total billed charges incl. ancillaries. Cross-check against Sched Chgs + the W-AK breakouts.

label: Scheduled Charges
notes: Contractual base rent on occupied units. Drives Scheduled GPR (Section D B27) and avg-sched-per-unit metrics.

label: Balance (AR)
notes: Total AR balance per unit. Drives N5 Total AR, the delinquency tiers (<500 / >=500), and Top-10 delinquent list. Also present (and should reconcile) in the AR doc col J.

label: Deposit Held
notes: Security deposit. Feeds Net Exposure (Balance - Deposit) on the Top-10 delinquent table.

label: AR Aging — 0-30 Days
notes: Aging lives in a SEPARATE AR doc and must be joined to the RR grid on Bldg-Unit. Template note (A88) says 'paste from separate aging report into cols Q-T'. Requires the resident-key join the future mf_ar parser will own. The AR doc is dated Mar 2026 vs RR Apr 2026 — period-mismatch caveat.

label: AR Aging — 31-60 Days
notes: See rr_ar_0_30 — same AR-join gap.

label: AR Aging — 61-90 Days
notes: See rr_ar_0_30 — same AR-join gap.

label: AR Aging — 90+ Days
notes: See rr_ar_0_30 — same AR-join gap. Drives D94 aging-ties reconciliation: SUM(Q:T) must equal col-O Total AR.

label: Status Flag
notes: Column U semantics unconfirmed; not in the operator RR. Defer until the writer pass clarifies whether it is analyst-input or derived.

label: Notes
source_label: Last Delinquency Note (from AR doc) — or free-form RR notes
notes: Best source is the AR doc's 'Last Delinquency Note' (joined on Bldg-Unit). Optional / informational column.

label: MTM Fees (per unit)
notes: Per-unit other-income breakout mirroring _StdCOA. Not in the basic RR doc; only the Sortable-RR 'Source Data' charge-code grid carries per-fee detail. Future mf_ parser must map charge codes -> buckets.

notes: See rr_anc_mtm_fees — ancillary breakout gap.

notes: See rr_anc_mtm_fees — ancillary breakout gap.

label: Account #
notes: PSI account number. Direct paste into Layer 1 col A. 101 GL lines on Hidden Lakes.

label: Account Name (raw)
notes: Raw PSI account name. Direct paste into Layer 1 col B.

label: 12 monthly columns (Apr-25..Mar-26)
notes: Direct 12-month paste block. Source period (Apr 2025-Mar 2026) aligns with the template's month headers. Layer 1 col O re-derives T-12 Total via =SUM(C:N); Layer 3 SUMIFS aggregate by bucket.

label: T-12 Total (per line)
notes: Self-derives from the pasted monthly block. The operator T-12 has its own Total in col O; the template recomputes to stay internally consistent.

label: → MAPPING (_StdCOA bucket per line)
notes: THE intelligence layer of the T-12 path — the MF equivalent of ALF's Description_Map. Every Layer-3 SUMIFS keys on this string. A future mf_t12 normalizer must classify each raw line into a _StdCOA bucket. Pre-filled example mappings exist on rows 106-185 for Hidden Lakes (analyst-authored), demonstrating the target vocabulary.
